verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይውህበከ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁየ፡ ትጠቡ፡ አጥባቲሃ፡ ለእምከ። ረኪብየ፡ በአፍኣ፡ እስዕመከ። ወኢይሜንኑኒ።
verses.translation: I would that thou, O my kinsman, wert he that sucked the breasts of my mother; when I found thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, they should not despise me.

translations.lxx: I would that thou, O my kinsman, wert he that sucked the breasts of my mother; when I found thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, they should not despise me.
translations.kjv: O that thou wert as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! when I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
translations.ron: O, de mi-ai fi fost tu fratele meu şi să fi supt la sinul mamei mele, atunci pe uliţă de te-ntâlneam, cu drag, prelung te sărutam şi nimeni nu-ndrăznea osândei să mă dea.

verses.geez: እነሥአከ፡ ወኣበውአከ፡ ውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ እምየ። ወውስተ፡ ውሳጥያቲሃ፡ ለእንተ፡ ሐፀነተኒ። ኣሰትየከ፡ እምርሔ፡ አፈውየ። ወእምስቴ፡ ሮማንየ።
verses.translation: I would take thee, I would bring thee into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me; I would make thee to drink of spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranates.

translations.lxx: I would take thee, I would bring thee into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me; I would make thee to drink of spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranates.
translations.kjv: I would lead thee, and bring thee into my mother’s house, who would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
translations.ron: Te-aş fi luat şi-n casa mamei te-aş fi dus, în casa celei ce m-a născut; tu graiuri dulci mi-ai fi spus şi eu cu drag ţi-aş fi dat vin bun şi must de rodii.

verses.translation: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.

translations.lxx: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
translations.kjv: His left hand should be under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
translations.ron: Stânga sa este sub capul meu şi cu dreapta-i mă cuprinde.

verses.geez: አመሐልኩክን፡ አዋልደ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም። በኀይሉ፡ ወበጽንዑ፡ ለገዳም። አመ፡ ተንሥአ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ኵሎ፡ ሙታነ። አፈቅሮ፡ እስከ፡ አመ፡ ፈቀደ።
verses.translation: I have charged you, ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the virtues of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.

translations.lxx: I have charged you, ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the virtues of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
translations.kjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake my love, until he please.
translations.ron: Fete din Ierusalim, vă jur pe cerboaicele şi gazele din câmp, nu treziţi pe draga mea până nu-i va fi ei voia!

verses.geez: መኑ፡ ይእቲ፡ ዛቲ፡ እንተ፡ ትሔውጽ፡ ከመ፡ ጎሕ። ጽዕዱት፡ ወብርህት። እንተ፡ ትትመረጐዝ፡ በወልድ፡ እኁሃ። እምኀበ፡ ኮል፡ አንሣእኩከ። ኮልኬ፡ ዘበዕብራይዲ፡ እለ፡ ቅቡዓን፡ በደመ፡ ሐርጌ፡ ዘገለዓድ።
verses.translation: Who is this that comes up all white, leaning on her kinsman? I raised thee up under an apple-tree; there thy mother brought thee forth; there she that bore thee brought thee forth.

translations.lxx: Who is this that comes up all white, leaning on her kinsman? I raised thee up under an apple-tree; there thy mother brought thee forth; there she that bore thee brought thee forth.
translations.kjv: Who is this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth that bare thee.
translations.ron: Cine se înalţă din pustiu, sprijinită de-al său drag? Sub mărul acesta am trezit iubirea ta, aici unde te-a născut şi ţi-a dat lumina zilei mama ta.

verses.geez: በህየ፡ ሐመት፡ ብከ፡ እምከ። ወበህየ፡ ሐመት፡ ብከ፡ እምከ፡ ወላዲትከ። ደቂቀ፡ ይሣኮር፡ ይሣለቁ፡ ብከ።
verses.translation: Set me as a seal upon thy heart, as a seal upon thine arm; for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave, her shafts are shafts of fire, even the flames thereof.

translations.lxx: Set me as a seal upon thy heart, as a seal upon thine arm; for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave, her shafts are shafts of fire, even the flames thereof.
translations.kjv: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love is strong as death; jealousy is cruel as the grave: the coals thereof are coals of fire, which hath a most vehement flame.
translations.ron: Ca pecete pe sânul tău mă poartă, poartă-mă pe mâna ta ca pe o brăţară! Că iubirea ca moartea e de tare şi ca iadul de grozavă este gelozia. Săgeţile ei sunt săgeţi de foc şi flacăra ei ca fulgerul din cer.

verses.geez: አንብረኒ፡ ከመ፡ ሕልቀት፡ ውስተ፡ ልብከ። ወከመ፡ ማዕተብ፡ በመዝራዕትከ። እስመ፡ ፍቅር፡ ከመ፡ ሞት፡ ጽንዕት። ወርቅ፡ ወዮሣር፡ ኢይከውኑ፡ ሤጣ። ወድርክት፡ ከመ፡ ሲኦል።
verses.translation: Much water will not be able to quench love, and rivers shall not drown it; if a man would give all his substance for love, men would utterly despise it.

translations.lxx: Much water will not be able to quench love, and rivers shall not drown it; if a man would give all his substance for love, men would utterly despise it.
translations.kjv: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if a man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
translations.ron: Marea nu poate stinge dragostea, nici râurile s-o potolească; de-ar da cineva pentru iubire toate comorile casei sale, cu dispreţ ar fi respins acela.

verses.geez: ቅንዓት፡ ትበልዖሙ፡ ለልበ፡ ብዙኃን፡ በመዓት። እስመ፡ በቅንዓትሰ፡ ኢይትረከብ፡ ጸጋ። ክነፊሃ፡ ክንፈ፡ እሳት፡ ላህባ።
verses.translation: Our sister is little, and has no breasts; what shall we do for our sister, in the day wherein she shall be spoken for?

translations.lxx: Our sister is little, and has no breasts; what shall we do for our sister, in the day wherein she shall be spoken for?
translations.kjv: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
translations.ron: Avem o mică surioară, care sâni nu are încă. Ce-am face cu sora noastră, când ea ar fi peţită?

verses.geez: ማይ፡ ብዙኅ፡ ኢይክል፡ አጥፍኦታ፡ ለፍቅር። ወአፍላግኒ፡ ኢያንቀለቅልዋ። እመ፡ ወሀበ፡ ብእሲ፡ ኵሎ፡ ንብረቶ፡ ለፍቅር። መንኖ፡ ኢይሜንንዎ።
verses.translation: If she is a wall, let us build upon her silver bulwarks; and if she is a door, let us carve for her cedar panels.

translations.lxx: If she is a wall, let us build upon her silver bulwarks; and if she is a door, let us carve for her cedar panels.
translations.kjv: If she be a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she be a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
translations.ron: Zid de piatră de-ar fi ea, coroană de argint i-am face; iar uşă dac-ar fi, cu lemn de cedru am căptuşi-o.

verses.geez: እኅትነ፡ ንስቲት፡ ይእቲ፡ ወአጥባት፡ አልባ። ምንተ፡ ንግበር፡ ለእኅትነ፡ በዕለት፡ አመ፡ ይትናገሩ፡ ባቲ።
verses.translation: I am a wall, and my breasts are as towers; I was in their eyes as one that found peace.

translations.lxx: I am a wall, and my breasts are as towers; I was in their eyes as one that found peace.
translations.kjv: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
translations.ron: Zid sunt eu acum şi sânii mei sunt turnuri; drept aceea în ochii lui eu am aflat pacea.

verses.geez: ለእመ፡ አረፍት፡ ይእቲ፡ ንሕንጽ፡ ዲቤሃ፡ ተድባበ፡ ዘብሩር። ወለእመ፡ ኆኅት፡ ይእቲ፡ ንግበር፡ ላቲ፡ ማዕጾ፡ ዘቄድሮስ። ማኅፈደ፡ ቀይሕ፡ ዘያነክት፡ ለሰሎሞን፡ በኬብሮን።
verses.translation: Solomon had a vineyard in Beelamon; he let his vineyard to keepers; every one was to bring for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.

translations.lxx: Solomon had a vineyard in Beelamon; he let his vineyard to keepers; every one was to bring for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.
translations.kjv: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand pieces of silver.
translations.ron: Solomon avea o vie pe coasta Baal-Hamon; el a dat via lucrătorilor, s-o lucreze şi să-i dea fiecare la rod o mie de sicli de argint.

verses.geez: አነ፡ ቅጽር፡ ወአጥባትየ፡ ከመ፡ ማኅፈድ። አነ፡ እንተ፡ በአዕይንቲሁ፡ እረክብ፡ ሰላመ።
verses.translation: My vineyard, even mine, is before me; Solomon shall have a thousand, and they that keep its fruit two hundred.

translations.lxx: My vineyard, even mine, is before me; Solomon shall have a thousand, and they that keep its fruit two hundred.
translations.kjv: My vineyard, which is mine, is before me: thou, O Solomon, must have a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
translations.ron: Via mea este la mine acasă; mia de sicli să fie a ta, Solomoane, şi două sute numai pentru cei ce păzesc roadele ei!

verses.geez: ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ ኮነ፡ ለሰሎሞን፡ በብዔላሞን። ወወሀበ፡ ዐጸደ፡ ወይኑ፡ ለእለ፡ የዐቅቡ፡ ፍሬሁ። ብእሲ፡ ብእሲ፡ ይውህብ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ በበጊዜሁ።
verses.translation: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: make me hear it.

translations.lxx: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: make me hear it.
translations.kjv: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear it.
translations.ron: O, tu, ce în grădini sălăşluieşti, prietenii vor să-ţi asculte glasul; fă-mă să-l aud şi eu cu ei!

verses.geez: ዐጸደ፡ ወይን፡ ሊተ፡ አንጻርየ። እንዘ፡ ይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ካልኣን፡ ርእይዎ። ጉቡአን፡ ወስንእዋን፡ እንዘ፡ ይነብሩ፡ በሰላም። ወካልአን፡ ርእይዎሙ።
verses.translation: Away, my kinsman, and be like a doe or a fawn on the mountains of spices.

translations.lxx: Away, my kinsman, and be like a doe or a fawn on the mountains of spices.
translations.kjv: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
translations.ron: Fugi degrab, iubitul meu, sprinten ca o căprioară fii, fii ca puiul cel de cerb, peste munţii cei îmbălsămaţi!

verses.geez: ወእንዘ፡ ይትረዐዩ፡ ማዕከላ። ወእንዘ፡ የሐውሩ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነት፡ ካልአን።
ቃለከ፡ አስምዐኒ። ጕይ፡ አንተ፡ ወልድ፡ እኁየ፡ ወተመሰላ፡ ለወይጠል። ወከመ፡ ወሬዛ፡ ሀየል፡ ውስተ፡ አድባረ፡ ድኁኃን።
